title: SAM config.json
description: Project-level workflow configuration for SAM. Tune process weight without breaking the state machine. Defaults favor milestone-level gates: code_review, formal_approval, and documentation_update all default to every_milestone, and re_review_trigger defaults to auto. Missing file or missing key = default.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

code_review.description: How often Principal.CodeReview runs after Staff.ImplementationExecution. 'every_phase' = always. 'every_milestone' = only on the last phase of each milestone, reviewing all phases of the milestone (default). 'never' = skip code review entirely, route straight to PM.StatusUpdate.

formal_approval.description: How often Human.PhaseApproval runs. 'every_phase' = always. 'every_milestone' = only on the last phase of each milestone, briefing the whole milestone (default). 'never' = skip formal approval entirely (Human.ApproveMilestone still applies).

documentation_update.description: How often Writer.DocumentationUpdate runs. 'every_phase' = always. 'every_milestone' = only on the last phase of each milestone (default). 'never' = skip documentation updates entirely.

review_strictness.description: Threshold for REQUIRED vs. SUGGESTED findings in Principal.CodeReview. 'strict' = deviations from STANDARDS/DECISIONS are REQUIRED; best-practice violations are pushed harder. 'balanced' = correctness issues and clear standard violations are REQUIRED; style preferences are SUGGESTED (default). 'pragmatic' = only correctness and security issues are REQUIRED; everything else is SUGGESTED.

re_review_trigger.description: When Staff.ReviewReconciliation changes code, should it always trigger a re-review? 'required' = always route back to Principal.CodeReview if any code changed. 'auto' = AI judges whether the scope/nature of changes warrants re-review and documents reasoning (default).

status_updates.description: How often plans/STATUS.md is updated. 'every_action' = every action that currently writes STATUS continues to (backward compatible). 'pm_only' = only PM.StatusUpdate writes STATUS; other actions skip the write. Routing inserts PM.StatusUpdate after Human.ApproveBuild, Human.ApproveMilestone, and Principal.PlanDiversion (scopes a/b) so major transitions are still captured (default). 'every_milestone' = like pm_only, but PM.StatusUpdate writes only on the last phase of each milestone. 'never' = STATUS is not updated (Product.ProductVision creates a disabled stub; PM.StatusUpdate normalizes to the stub if it sees a non-stub file). Under any setting except every_action, expect a one-phase STATUS lag during transitions.

workspace.description: Multi-root workspace configuration. Defines the primary repo (which owns plans/) and any shared repos that receive code/STANDARDS/DECISIONS updates without their own plans/ wrapper. For single-repo projects, define primary_repo and leave shared_repos empty. SAM never infers the primary repo from cwd or '.'; it must be explicit.

primary_repo.description: The repo that owns plans/. There is exactly one primary repo per workspace.

name.description: Human-readable name for the primary repo.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the primary repo root.

owns_plans.description: Always true. The primary repo always owns plans/.

shared_repos.description: Repos that may receive code edits plus STANDARDS.md / DECISIONS.md updates (no plans/ wrapper). Omit or leave empty for single-repo projects. The path field is matched against file edits to determine shared scope.

name.description: Human-readable name for the shared repo.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the shared repo root. Edits whose paths match this prefix are classified as shared scope.

role.description: Brief description of the repo's role in the workspace (e.g., 'shared backend', 'design system').
